Included files:
- NNModels.py
- models_verified/LASA/Sine/model_f.pth

These files are included with permission from the S2NNDS project owner.

NNModels.py is adapted only to replace the upstream wildcard import from
common_header.py with the torch imports needed to unpickle and evaluate the
included dynamics model. This avoids importing S2NNDS training-only GUI and
experiment dependencies.
